title: Choose your speech model
body: Models stay on this computer. Choose a size for its memory and processing power.
label: English speech model

title: Install and verify models
body: Download the chosen speech model and speaker-label models. Every file must pass its size and SHA-256 checks. A failure stays here for retry.

title: Choose your microphone
body: Select the input to use for dictation and microphone audio in meetings.
label: Microphone

title: Choose and test your microphone
body: Confirm that Voice receives an audio signal before dictation is enabled. The short test is not saved.

title: Choose your dictation controls
body: Review toggle and push-to-talk bindings. You can also choose on-screen controls without global keyboard access. Custom bindings remain configurable in Settings.
label: Dictation controls
options: Right Control toggles dictation; push-to-talk off
Hold Right Control to talk; toggle off
On-screen controls; both global bindings off

title: Choose text insertion
body: Copy mode keeps results ready for manual paste. Automatic insertion requires Accessibility access for {app}.
label: Text insertion

title: Review keyboard and paste permissions
body: Check access required by your chosen controls and text insertion for {app}. Unused permissions remain off.
success: Required access verified; unused capabilities remain off.
help: In System Settings → Privacy & Security, enable {app}. If macOS requests a restart, quit and reopen {app}, then check again. Setup resumes here.

title: Review meeting settings
body: Calendar connections are optional. Meeting recording always asks for local audio retention and system audio access when needed. No recording bot joins calls.
label: Calendar integration

title: Review startup and updates
body: {app} manages startup and updates. Closing the window can leave background tools running; Quit stops them after active work is saved.
label: I reviewed startup, update ownership, and how to quit.

title: Ready to use Voice
body: Setup is complete only after required checks and all settings choices. You can change these later in Settings.
